name: tr_bosh
caption:
IF BOSH HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

💾 Porygon: made entirely of programming code. Studied computer imaging at Georgia Tech, then our No. 4 pick in 2003
🐲 Zweilous: two heads, both always eating. Our double-double record holder, 24.0 points and 10.8 boards in 2009-10
🌿 Tangrowth: ensnares anything nearby with its vines. Left as our all-time leader in rebounds and blocks
🦅 Braviary: a brave warrior that fights for its friends. Our captain, our first-ever division title in 2006-07
⭐ Starmie: its core glows like a gem. 5-time All-Star with us
🦖 Aerodactyl: flew fearlessly through prehistoric skies. Left as our all-time points leader, Hall of Fame in 2021

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Chris Bosh had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF CHRIS BOSH HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Porygon. Made entirely of code. Chris studied computer imaging, then we took him fourth in twenty oh three.
beats.dlg: MADE ENTIRELY OF CODE.|2003: OUR NO. 4 PICK

beats.vo: Zweilous. Two heads, both always eating. Chris set our record for double-doubles. His last year with us: twenty-four points, ten point eight boards.
beats.dlg: TWO HEADS, BOTH FEASTING.|OUR DOUBLE-DOUBLE RECORD

beats.vo: Tangrowth. It ensnares anything that wanders near with its vines. When Chris left, he was our all-time leader in rebounds and blocks.
beats.dlg: ITS VINES ENSNARE PREY.|OUR ALL-TIME REBOUND KING

beats.vo: Braviary. A brave warrior that fights for its friends. Twenty oh seven: our captain leads us to our first division title ever.
beats.dlg: IT FIGHTS FOR ITS FRIENDS.|2007: FIRST DIVISION TITLE

beats.vo: Starmie. Its core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Chris was an All-Star five times with us.
beats.dlg: ITS CORE GLOWS LIKE A GEM.|5X ALL-STAR WITH US

beats.vo: And the ace. Aerodactyl. It flew fearlessly through prehistoric skies. Chris left as our all-time points leader, and made the Hall of Fame in twenty twenty-one.
beats.dlg: FEARLESS IN ANCIENT SKIES.|HALL OF FAME: 2021

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Bosh enrolled at Georgia Tech to study graphic design and computer imaging; selected fourth overall (No. 4) by Toronto in the 2003 NBA draft; named one of Toronto's team captains before 2005-06; on March 28, 2007 became the franchise record holder for double-doubles; in 2006-07 (2007) led Toronto to its first-ever division title; a five-time (5X) NBA All-Star with the Raptors; left the Raptors in 2010 (his last season 2009-10) as the franchise's all-time leader in points, rebounds, blocks and minutes; inducted into the Hall of Fame in 2021
